function_summary:### Final Analysis Report
Based on comprehensive research using web search, crawl data, and domain expertise, I've analyzed each candidate library against the core functionality of **org.reflections:reflections** using the Two Core Investigation Rules:

#### 1. **io.github.classgraph:classgraph**
- **Relationship Type**: MODERN_REPLACEMENT  
- **Evidence Summary**:  
  ClassGraph is a direct modern functional replacement that solves the same core problem of classpath scanning and metadata indexing more efficiently. It outperforms Reflections in speed (parallel scanning), handles modern JVM features (JPMS modules), and provides richer metadata APIs. A modern developer would choose ClassGraph for its superior performance, active maintenance, and comprehensive feature set that includes annotation scanning, method signature discovery, and resource indexing while requiring minimal migration effort.  
- **Confidence**: High  
- **Supporting URLs**:  
  [ClassGraph GitHub](https://github.com/classgraph/classgraph)  
  [Reflections vs ClassGraph Comparison](https://www.libhunt.com/compare-reflections-vs-classgraph)  
  [Classpath Scanning Benchmark](https://www.javacodegeeks.com/2024/12/fastclasspathscanner-supercharging-classpath-scanning-in-java.html)

#### 2. **io.github.lukehutch:fast-classpath-scanner**
- **Relationship Type**: MODERN_REPLACEMENT  
- **Evidence Summary**:  
  This library is the original incarnation of ClassGraph (renamed in 2018), sharing identical core functionality and codebase. As confirmed by project history and maintainer communications, it represents the same modern functional replacement pattern as ClassGraph, offering identical solutions to Reflections' core problems with optimized performance and modern API design.  
- **Confidence**: High  
- **Supporting URLs**:  
  [Renaming Announcement](https://groups.google.com/g/classgraph-users/c/aC_mVkTgrs0)  
  [Original GitHub Repository](https://github.com/jknack/fast-classpath-scanner)

#### 3. **eu.infomas:annotation-detector**
- **Relationship Type**: Specialized Functional Replacement  
- **Evidence Summary**:  
  Annotation-detector provides a specialized solution for annotation scanning but lacks Reflections' comprehensive classpath scanning capabilities. It solves a subset of the original problem (annotation discovery) with higher efficiency but doesn't support broader metadata queries like subtype discovery or method signature scanning. A developer might choose this for lightweight annotation processing while still needing Reflections for other metadata operations.  
- **Confidence**: Medium  
- **Supporting URLs**:  
  [Reflections Alternatives List](https://java.libhunt.com/reflections-alternatives)
